entities.name: Mindskinner
entities.description: A spider-like nightmare enchantment creature on Duskmourn that slices away its victims' memories.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane on which the Mindskinner lives.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: The people whose fear the Mindskinner embodies.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The being whose ascension marks when preexisting fears became nightmares.

entities.name: Glimmer
entities.description: Something that protects against the Mindskinner's memory slicing when kept nearby.

events.summary: The Mindskinner latches onto victims and slices away their memories one by one until only fear remains.
events.quote: it slices away the target's memories one by one until nothing remains but an all-encompassing fear

relations.quote: The Mindskinner embodies the fear of razorkin
